toastUnsupportedImage: Unsupported image format. Use PNG, JPG, SVG, WebP or GIF.
toastLogoTooLarge: Logo image is too large (max 5 MB).
themeRedLightSubtitle: A bright red theme for daytime use
themeBlueLightSubtitle: A bright blue theme for daytime use
fullscreenOnLaunchDesc: Open the app in fullscreen when it starts. Press F11 any time to exit or re-enter fullscreen. Takes effect next launch.
launchOnStartupDesc: Start automatically when your computer boots.
beMotherLabel: Be the mother on this device
beMotherDesc: Host the games on this device when the app starts. If no other mother is already running, this device takes the role and (in hotspot mode) raises the Wi-Fi hotspot so satellites can reconnect. Several devices can have this on - whichever starts first becomes the mother; the rest join it. Takes effect next launch.
operatorOnlyDesc: Manage and launch games from this device without ever playing on it.
operatorOnlyExplainer: Turn this on when this computer will never be played on - only used to set up and launch games for other devices. It then downloads only each game's data and cover image (not the full media or tutorial videos), saving disk space, and doesn't need a card reader or its driver. Switching this setting re-syncs your content.
operatorOnlyActiveGameBlock: Finish or end the active game on this device before changing this setting.
operatorOnlyFailed: Couldn't update the device role. Please try again.
operatorOnlyConfirmEnable: Downloaded game media on this device will be removed to free space, and content will re-sync keeping only each game's data and cover image. Continue?
operatorOnlyConfirmDisable: This device will re-download the full game media so games can be played on it. This may be large and take some time. Continue?
pinExitGameLabel: Require PIN to exit a running game
pinExitGameDesc: Ask for the device PIN before leaving a running game or opening the operator panel. Stops players from exiting or ending the game. Uses your device PIN.
pinExitLogoLabel: Require PIN to exit the logo screen
pinExitLogoDesc: Ask for the device PIN before dismissing the logo screen - at launch and when raised from the nav bar. Turns the logo screen into a step-away lock. Uses your device PIN.
pinExitFullscreenDesc: Ask for the device PIN before F11 leaves fullscreen. Keeps players from dropping out of the kiosk view. Uses your device PIN.
logoScreenOnLaunchDesc: Show a branded logo screen instead of the home page when the app starts. Tap anywhere to continue. Takes effect next launch.
logoHint: PNG, JPG, SVG or WebP. A transparent background works best. Without a custom logo the TagHunter logo is shown.
animationHint: A subtle glow that hugs the logo. Works best on a transparent logo; an opaque one glows by its rectangle.
noCustomLogo: No custom logo - showing the TagHunter logo.
readerDetectionDesktopOnly: Reader detection is only available inside the Tauri desktop app.
readerDetectedHint: Detected by USB VID/PID. The app auto-binds at game start.
driverBlockedTitle: We see a SportIdent reader, but Windows blocked its driver
driverBlockedDesc: The Vulnerable Driver Blocklist is refusing the legacy silabser.sys. Install the signed driver to fix it - no Memory Integrity change needed.
driverBlockedCta: Fix it in USB driver settings
driverNotInstalledTitle: We see a SportIdent reader, but its driver isn't installed
driverNotInstalledDesc: Windows has no driver bound to the reader (Device Manager shows it under "Other devices", code 28). Install the SportIdent USB driver to bring it online.
driverNotInstalledCta: Install it from USB driver settings
noReaderDesc: Plug in your reader. The footer's reader indicator will turn green when it's online.
noReaderCta: Driver blocked or missing? Open USB driver settings
cardReaderTestDesktopOnly: Reader test is only available inside the Tauri desktop app.
plugInReaderToTest: Plug in your SportIdent reader to enable the test.
errorFailedToOpenPort: Failed to open the port. Check the cable, that no other app holds it, and try Refresh above.
statusListening: Listening - punch a card into the station to see its data appear.
noCardsYet: No cards yet. Start the test, then punch a card to see its data here.
